title: 'The Regent's Writ' quest text ('Cinderhall's chapterhouse will write the Regent's writ for the crown road, once two hollows of the Reach have burned') only ever describes the burn-two-hollows path. The alternate, non-destructive route ('give this Watch two honest services') is never mentioned anywhere in the quest log and only surfaces in dialogue with the Marrowgate envoy once you physically reach Highward — a player tracking Watch reputation has no signal that path exists.
where: quest log 'The Regent's Writ' vs. dialogue at Highward — The Captain-General's Hall
